caseNameFull: Donovan v. Queensboro Corporation and Donovan v. Queensboro Corporation
attorneys: Edward F. Clark and John A. Shorten for petitioner., Charles H. Tuttle for respondents.

opinions.text: In No. 156 the petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit is denied. In No. 49, Mise., the motion for leave to file petition for writ of certiorari is denied.
